findings.issue: Rating range check uses && instead of ||, so it never rejects out-of-range values
findings.evidence: if (!Number.isInteger(rating) || (rating < 1 && rating > 5)) — rating can't be <1 AND >5 simultaneously, so any integer (0, -5, 100) passes and is persisted via Review.updateReview on PUT /reviews/:id/rating

findings.issue: SQL injection via unsanitized sort parameter interpolated into ORDER BY clause
findings.evidence: ORDER BY ${sort} in getReviewsSorted; api.ts passes (req.query.sort as string) || 'r.created_at DESC' directly from GET /books/:id/reviews?sort=... with no allowlist (contrast with getBooksPage's BOOK_SORT_COLUMNS allowlist)

findings.issue: Stored XSS: top.display_name interpolated unescaped into HTML response
findings.evidence:
res.send(`
${top.display_name} rated it ${top.rating}/5
`) on GET /books/:id/top-review; display_name originates from user-controlled displayName field and is never escaped, unlike sibling routes using res.render

findings.issue: Pagination offset off-by-one: page 1 skips the first pageSize rows
findings.evidence: OFFSET computed as page * pageSize; function's own comment says "page starts at 1" but with page=1 offset=pageSize, so GET /books/page?page=1 returns the second page of results, never the first
